The group did indeed engage in a discussion about the most hateable characters in Game of Thrones, starting with Emily Burnett initiating a poll titled "Who do you think is the most hateable character in Game of Thrones?" Participants included Emily Burnett, Niamh, Orion, Merrick, Phaedra, LiHua, Tamara, Merrick, Lachlan, Emily Burnett, Saffron, Kieran, and Tamara. 

In the first discussion, Emily Burnett asked the group to vote on their choices for the most hateable characters, specifically mentioning Joffrey Baratheon, Ramsay Bolton, and Cersei Lannister. The participants then narrowed it down to these three characters, with Joffrey Baratheon receiving the highest number of votes, followed closely by Ramsay Bolton and Cersei Lannister.

After the voting concluded, the group acknowledged the tie between Joffrey, Ramsay, and Cersei, concluding that all three deserved the title of "most hateable character." This discussion showcases the varied opinions and intense reactions to these characters among the group members, highlighting the multifaceted nature of the show's villains.
